pick.headline: Marcos flees the Philippines
pick.summary: On 25 February 1986 Ferdinand Marcos fled the Philippines on US aircraft as Corazon Aquino was sworn in as president.
pick.significance: The People Power revolution ended twenty years of Marcos rule and became a model for peaceful revolutions elsewhere.

alternates.headline: Violeta Chamorro defeats the Sandinistas
alternates.summary: On 25 February 1990 Violeta Chamorro of the UNO opposition coalition defeated Daniel Ortega in Nicaragua's presidential election.
alternates.significance: The Sandinistas' acceptance of defeat ended a decade of revolutionary rule and the US-backed Contra war.

alternates.headline: Gunman massacres worshippers in Hebron
alternates.summary: On 25 February 1994 Baruch Goldstein, an Israeli settler, opened fire on Muslim worshippers in the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron, killing 29.
alternates.significance: The massacre nearly derailed the Oslo peace process and was followed by the first Hamas suicide bombings inside Israel.
